name: libvterm
purpose: ConPTY UTF-8/VT terminal state and replies; no launcher or worker dependency
modifications: Original files remain unchanged; screen.c is compiled through native_terminal_screen.c, which appends the registered frontend-local cell/cursor import using the pinned private layout
excluded: Upstream tests, programs, examples, Makefile and scripts do not compile or execute in product builds
materialization: Extract the pinned source only under repository build; no upstream worktree or runtime dependency
